review_type: Codex internal reading of the preselected L4 16-prompt subset; no independent human scores

L1-48.contact_and_completeness: Usually long enough but often runs to the generation cap; p18 emits writing instructions and p50 explains a refrain instead of delivering it.
L1-48.imagery_cadence_ambiguity: p16 has a moth and exit image, but p06 and p33 develop into long prose. The writing remains uneven.

L4-35.contact_and_completeness: p04 places rain outside the hospital, p18 invokes sailors near a lighthouse meant to be far from water, and p50 omits voicemail and refrain. Several medium prompts end mid-thought.
L4-35.imagery_cadence_ambiguity: p06 and p16 have useful images; p43 is lyric-shaped. p33 and p42 drift into extended prose.

L5-25.contact_and_completeness: Length is usually met, but p07 misses jealousy, p18 repeats writing instructions, and p50 explains refrain construction instead of writing the requested piece. Several responses hit the token cap mid-thought.
L5-25.imagery_cadence_ambiguity: p16 has a compact moth image and p48 supplies a verse/chorus form, but p01, p10, p29, p33, and p42 are ordinary narrative prose; p38 becomes a pseudo-scientific essay and p43 a book synopsis. Overall voice is generic and explanatory.

L5-35.contact_and_completeness: p04 is in a hospital during rain and p48 gives a verse/chorus response. p16 adds an unrelated text-editing instruction; p18 still brings ships near the landlocked beacon, p50 mentions a phone message but has no growing refrain, and p06 ends mid-sentence.
L5-35.imagery_cadence_ambiguity: p06 has a glass-and-river image and p43 has line-broken cadence. p02 uses stock sun/light rhyme, p10 and p33 ramble in prose, p29 invents a long narrative, p42 is one sprawling sentence, and p38 loses its central salt-taste image. The language is not a clear creative improvement over L4-35 or L1.

L5-50.contact_and_completeness: p01 and p02 shrink to one line; p06, p12, p18, and p50 are far below their requested lengths or miss defining concepts. p50 contains neither voicemail nor a growing refrain.
L5-50.imagery_cadence_ambiguity: More line breaks and short lyric shapes appear, but many images are undeveloped and generic.

selection: L5-35 is the best L5 writing-review candidate; L5-25 has stronger numeric length adherence but marked explanatory prose drift. L5-35 is not a clear win over L4-35 and neither clears the L1 creative-quality gate.
limitations: Internal qualitative assessment is not a blinded independent human preference score; automated contact and tail checks are proxies.
